class.name: mycobot280_moveit2_control/MyCobot280HardwareInterface
class.description: ros2_control SystemInterface for the mycobot280 M5 arm. Bridges MoveIt2 / ros2_control to the existing Python driver (mycobot_driver_node.py) via std_msgs/Float64MultiArray topics. The hardware interface publishes joint position commands to /mycobot/cmd_joint_pos and subscribes to /mycobot/current_joint_pos to read the joint state.
